blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 NAGOYA–Thailand is the latest country to slam the organization at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in Japan, likening it to a “chaotic” game of “musical chairs”. Athletes have complained of poor accommodation, long delays at airports and in boarding cruise ship housing. Erratic transport services have seen competitors’ buses to training and venues turning up late, or in some cases not at all.
